scenes.title: PaperDispatch
points: Exam papers, delivered right on time
scenes.narration: Still sending exam papers by email? Meet Paper Dispatch.

scenes.title: Upload once. Reach every college.
scenes.narration: Upload question papers, and schedule exams across every affiliated college, in one place.

scenes.title: Unlocks only when the exam begins
scenes.narration: Each paper unlocks only when its exam begins. Not a minute earlier.

scenes.title: Logged. Deleted. Never early.
scenes.narration: Every download is logged, and papers are deleted automatically after seven days.

scenes.title: Sign in. Download. Done.
scenes.narration: College admins just sign in, and download each paper the moment its window opens.
